from AlgorithmImports import *
from collections import deque
from math import floor


class SpecifiedStrategySystem(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=201)
        self.aapl_previous_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
            self.aapl,
            14,
            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
            Resolution.Daily
        )

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                return

        spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
        aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close

        self.spy_closes.append(spy_close)

        if self.aapl_previous_close is not None and aapl_close < self.aapl_previous_close:
            self.aapl_red_streak += 1
        else:
            self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_close

        if len(self.spy_closes) < 201 or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
            return

        closes = list(self.spy_closes)

        previous_spy_close = closes[-2]
        current_sma_200 = sum(closes[-200:]) / 200
        previous_sma_200 = sum(closes[-201:-1]) / 200
        current_sma_50 = sum(closes[-50:]) / 50
        previous_sma_50 = sum(closes[-51:-1]) / 50

        # Evaluate all sells before any buys.
        if self.strategy_a_lot > 0:
            sma_50_crosses_below_sma_200 = (
                previous_sma_50 >= previous_sma_200
                and current_sma_50 < current_sma_200
            )
            if sma_50_crosses_below_sma_200:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                self.strategy_a_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
            self.strategy_b_lot = 0

        if self.strategy_a_lot == 0:
            spy_crosses_above_sma_200 = (
                previous_spy_close <= previous_sma_200
                and spy_close > current_sma_200
            )
            if spy_crosses_above_sma_200:
                shares = floor((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = shares

        if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                shares = floor(20_000 / aapl_close)
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = shares

from AlgorithmImports import *

class IndependentStrategySlots(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)
        self.SetWarmUp(200, Resolution.Daily)

        self.symbols = {
            ticker: self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol
            for ticker in ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
        }

        self.spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
        self.aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]

        self.spy_sma_200 = SimpleMovingAverage(200)
        self.spy_sma_50 = SimpleMovingAverage(50)
        self.aapl_rsi_14 = RelativeStrengthIndex(14)

        self.previous_close = {symbol: None for symbol in self.symbols.values()}
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_200 = None
        self.previous_spy_sma_50 = None

        self.strategy_a_lot = 0
        self.strategy_b_lot = 0

    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
        bars = {}

        for symbol in self.symbols.values():
            if data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                bars[symbol] = data.Bars[symbol]

        # Keep all market-state quantities updating continuously whenever data exists.
        if self.spy in bars:
            spy_bar = bars[self.spy]
            self.spy_sma_200.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)
            self.spy_sma_50.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)

        if self.aapl in bars:
            aapl_bar = bars[self.aapl]
            self.aapl_rsi_14.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)

            prior_aapl_close = self.previous_close[self.aapl]
            if prior_aapl_close is not None and aapl_bar.Close < prior_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        # A missing bar for any subscribed ticker skips all rule evaluation.
        complete_day = len(bars) == len(self.symbols)

        if complete_day and not self.IsWarmingUp:
            indicators_ready = (
                self.spy_sma_200.IsReady
                and self.spy_sma_50.IsReady
                and self.aapl_rsi_14.IsReady
                and self.previous_spy_close is not None
                and self.previous_spy_sma_200 is not None
                and self.previous_spy_sma_50 is not None
            )

            if indicators_ready:
                spy_close = bars[self.spy].Close
                sma_200 = self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
                sma_50 = self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value

                # Evaluate sells before buys.
                if (
                    self.strategy_a_lot > 0
                    and self.previous_spy_sma_50 >= self.previous_spy_sma_200
                    and sma_50 < sma_200
                ):
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = 0

                if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi_14.Current.Value > 60:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                    self.strategy_b_lot = 0

                if (
                    self.strategy_a_lot == 0
                    and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma_200
                    and spy_close > sma_200
                ):
                    quantity = int(math.floor(
                        0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue / spy_close
                    ))
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                        self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

                if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
                    aapl_close = bars[self.aapl].Close
                    if self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000:
                        quantity = int(math.floor(20_000 / aapl_close))
                        if quantity > 0:
                            self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                            self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        if self.spy in bars:

            self.previous_spy_sma_200 = self.spy_sma_200.Current.Value
            self.previous_spy_sma_50 = self.spy_sma_50.Current.Value

        for symbol, bar in bars.items():
            self.previous_close[symbol] = bar.Close
